# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTER_BEARISH_ENTRY

**Filed:** 2026-09-05  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The engine loses on two of three J winner days (4/29, 5/01) when VIX is low, and wins on the high-VIX day (5/04). Adding a VIX >= 20 filter for bearish entries will avoid low-VIX losing trades on winner days and preserve the high-VIX winner, while avoiding low-VIX loser days where the engine currently breaks even (0 PnL) but risks losses if VIX is high.

## Mechanism

Add a pre-entry filter: require `vix >= 20.0` for bearish setup entries (BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON). This filter is evaluated alongside existing context filters. No changes to exit logic, position sizing, or other setups.
